blocks.text: Dear Mr Dupont, thank you for your request. I will confirm the tap replacement and pipe joint prices tomorrow morning.
Dear Mr Martin, thank you for your enquiry. I will confirm the boiler service price tomorrow morning.

{"script":"on mouseUp
  put "Thank you for your request; we will confirm the prices tomorrow morning." into field "Follow-up"
end mouseUp
","summary":"When the Draft button is clicked, the Follow-up field is set to the requested confirmation message.","assumptions":["The button "Draft" receives mouseUp when clicked, and this script is attached to that button.","The requested text should replace the existing content of field "Follow-up"."],"questions":[]}
